heading: Application to be made
content:
51.
Application to be made
(1)
On receipt of an application, in the specified form, from a building owner together with such plans as the Building Authority may require, he may permit in writing the erection of a temporary building.
(G.N.A. 83 of 1959; L.N. 350 of 1993)
(2)
A permit issued under this regulation may specify the period for which such temporary building may exist, and such other conditions as the Building Authority may deem necessary.
